project.title: Original reversible honeycomb printhead cover with Metrimade camera branding

coordinate_frame.origin: center of the circular fan badge on the visible cover face
coordinate_frame.transform_convention: row-major 4x4 matrix maps source coordinates to project millimetres

requirements.statement: Mount the spatial full-front add-on cover reversibly on the raised circular bezel, with four secondary side stabilizers, without modifying factory screws or shell.
requirements.source: user brief and official Anycubic service guide
requirements.verification: process-matched D50/D52/D54 full-envelope fit frame and physical installation test

requirements.statement: Cover the complete camera-facing printhead front with a lightweight honeycomb carrier while reserving the fan zone exclusively for the perforated M badge.
requirements.source: user brief and photo-scaled official service imagery
requirements.verification: front render, envelope check, and physical interference review

requirements.statement: Retain at least 60 percent projected open area across an assumed 40 mm intake disc and avoid any inward fan-blade intrusion.
requirements.source: design airflow proxy; exact fan performance not published
requirements.verification: deterministic projected-area calculation followed by fan-noise and thermal observation

requirements.statement: Use the supplied four-color M as an air-permeable grille and place its outlined wordmark on a closed plate above the fan intake.
requirements.verification: front render and real camera test video

requirements.statement: Print support-free with a 0.4 mm nozzle and preserve explicit aligned color bodies in 3MF.
requirements.verification: mesh/3MF checks and destination-slicer layer review

global_style.summary: spatial wraparound honeycomb shell with a perforated four-plane M exclusively in the fan zone and the supplied wordmark on a closed upper plate
global_style.generation_material: opaque same-family PETG in SVG navy, teal, aqua, and sand
global_style.detail_hierarchy: mount and airflow first, supplied vector lockup second, physical color match third

assembly_sequence: Measure the raised factory bezel and print the nearest full-envelope fit frame.
Print the matching cover visible face down with no supports.
Power off and cool the printer, then press the cover evenly onto the bezel while holding only the reinforced fan module.
Run staged fan, thermal, vibration, and camera checks before routine use.

decision_log.topic: Approve full-front shell silhouette, side engagement, and lower air-nozzle clearance.
decision_log.current_basis: Official front photographs and the documented 50 mm fan were proportion-scaled and rounded to an independent 72 by 88 mm face with 10.8 mm side fingers; no manufacturer shell drawing is published.
decision_log.evidence_needed: Physical D50/D52/D54 fit-frame result plus measured front width, height, and side engagement on the cooled, powered-off printhead.

decision_log.current_basis: Official uncalibrated photos suggest a range around 50-54 mm; D52 is the digital start candidate.
decision_log.evidence_needed: User caliper measurement and matching fit-coupon result.

decision_log.current_basis: Project owner supplied metrimade-lockup-horizontal-color.svg with outlined wordmark and four colors.
decision_log.evidence_needed: Physical filament swatches remain a separate appearance gate.

decision_log.topic: Approve exact Anycubic Slicer Next import, slot map, layer paths, and purge behavior.
decision_log.current_basis: Portable 3MF is generated, but the target slicer is unavailable in this environment.
decision_log.evidence_needed: Saved slicer project and reviewed preview.

decision_log.topic: Verify clearance of the closed upper wordmark plate against the printer front shell.
decision_log.current_basis: The 54 by 8.8 mm plate is inside the photo-scaled cover envelope and remains outside the assumed fan intake, but the stock shell surface is not dimensioned.
decision_log.evidence_needed: Physical D50/D52/D54 fit frame plus full-cover interference and camera check.

requirements.load_or_flow: retain approximately 12 g cover under print-head acceleration without shell damage

validation.method: validate hybrid design plan and unique interface ownership
validation.acceptance: no unresolved IDs; provisional dimensions remain explicit blockers

validation.method: compare the independent 72 by 88 mm face, 10.8 mm side fingers, upper 54 by 8.8 mm label plate, and six fan-clip sectors against official front-shell photographs and the lower-duct keep-out
validation.acceptance: full front is covered; honeycomb stays outside the fan module; label stays above intake; physical side-shell and duct clearance remain explicitly gated

validation.method: deterministic voxel surface and edge-incidence audit
validation.acceptance: positive volume, zero boundary edges, zero nonmanifold edges

validation.method: projected occupancy inside 40 and 42 mm intake discs
validation.acceptance: at least 60 percent open for the 40 mm proxy

validation.method: 3MF package/XML/reference/material check and final Anycubic Slicer Next preview
validation.acceptance: one aligned assembly, four named bodies, no dropped regions, maximum 16 planned changes

validation.method: full-envelope fit frame then complete prototype
validation.acceptance: moderate insertion/removal force, light side-finger contact, no shell marks or duct collision, no new fan noise/thermal issue, camera-readable branding
